pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Alpine's package manager. ::gentoo has none, and the alpine rootfs provider needs one on the build host: it runs apk with --arch, --root and --no-scripts to unpack a foreign-architecture Alpine root without executing a single target binary.
Category follows ::gentoo's placement of other distributions' package managers, app-arch/dpkg and app-arch/rpm.
The lua and python bindings for libapk are not built; nothing here consumes them, and each would drag in a language eclass. lua is still a build dependency because apk's own help database and shell completions are generated by a lua script from the scdoc man pages.

use.flag: Read and write zstd-compressed packages and indexes
